title: Concept: CocoaPods spec source declared over cleartext
description: Podfile declares a Podfile source URL that uses cleartext http, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Pod specs and their checksums cross the network unencrypted, so a network attacker can redirect a pod.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Podfile (cocoapods).
risk: Pod specs and their checksums cross the network unencrypted, so a network attacker can redirect a pod.
